correctness.rationale: The source betting fraction reduces exactly to \(L^{-1}\tanh(1/(2n+1))\) on odd rounds and to zero on even rounds. This forces every odd-indexed iterate after a completed pair back to the initialization. The intervening even iterate loses the fraction \(a_n\) of current wealth on the next outcome, giving \(W_n=W_{n-1}(1-a_n)\). The excursion equals \(P_{n-1}-P_n\), so the source average telescopes exactly. The \(n^{-1/2}\) wealth asymptotic follows from an exact harmonic-number decomposition and a convergent cosh product. Fresh replay of the embedded verifier confirms all finite identities and numerical constants.

value.rationale: COCOB's central mechanism is data-dependent wealth adaptation to gradient sign consistency. The source itself explains the equal-sign extreme; the balanced alternating extreme is the natural complementary stress test. The result is structurally sharp: it gives every iterate and wealth value, an exact telescoping formula for the source's convex output, and the precise high-frequency rejection exponent and constant. It also makes scale-freeness concrete by showing complete independence from the gradient magnitude \(L\).
